summary: Hillman Solutions Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Kanebridge, LLC on August 28, 2026, for approximately $315 million in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. The purchase was financed through cash on hand, revolving credit borrowings, and an additional $200 million of senior secured term loans added via Amendment No. 1 to its existing term loan credit agreement. The new term loans mature July 22, 2033, priced at SOFR plus 2.00% or ABR plus 1.00%, and are guaranteed by subsidiaries. Watch for post-closing working capital adjustment impacts and integration execution.
